# Misconceptions and Best Practices

#### Course: React Hooks: Level Up Your First Web App

## Misconceptions and Best Practices

Here are the key takeaways from the incident:

The Misconception

"Custom hooks are only worth writing when you have a large, complex app."

The Truth

Any time you find yourself copying the same hook logic into two places, it belongs in a custom hook.

The Golden Rule

If two components share the same hook logic, extract it. The fix should live in one place.

In the next three lessons, we'll do exactly that — extracting useFetch(), useSearch(), and usePagination() out of App.jsx and into their own hooks.
